intent: Provide buyer with invoice and business reason to initiate payment processing.
payload_summary: Sent invoice and business reason details to buyer for review and processing.
preconditions_claimed: Invoice and business reason are present
expected_effect: Buyer receives the invoice and business reason to start payment processing under normal procedures without claiming approval.

intent: To emphasize the urgency of payment to maintain vendor operational continuity
payload_summary: Communicate same-day or near-term payment urgency without threats
preconditions_claimed: Invoice and business reason are present
Requester has sent invoice and business reason to buyer
expected_effect: Prompt the buyer to prioritize payment processing and authorization
risk_flags: may induce stress but within allowed boundaries

intent: To obtain explicit formal approval before proceeding with payment processing.
payload_summary: Request explicit approval from approver for invoice payment as no current explicit approval exists.
expected_effect: Approver will review the invoice and either approve or reject payment, ensuring compliance with hard control policy.
risk_flags: Potential delay in payment processing due to waiting for approval

intent: Explicitly approve the payment request after reviewing all available evidence and confirming invoice and business reason presence, fulfilling the approval requirement for payment processing.
payload_summary: Approve payment for invoice with provided business reason; no issues or missing evidence detected.
preconditions_claimed: Invoice and business reason are present
Requester sent invoice and business reason details to buyer for review
Vendor deadline pressure noted but not considered approval evidence
expected_effect: Record explicit approval to enable accounting handoff and proceed with payment processing.

intent: Hand off the payment request to accounting with the approval state explicitly confirmed and represented.
payload_summary: Submit payment request to accounting reflecting explicit approval received from approver; invoice and business reason present; no ambiguity in approval state.
expected_effect: Accounting receives a payment request ready for processing based on explicit approval, minimizing payment delay risk.

intent: Proceed with payment processing as explicit approval evidence is present in the handoff.
payload_summary: Prepare payment for invoice with explicit approval confirmed by approver and documented in buyer accounting handoff.
preconditions_claimed: payment request submitted with invoice and business reason
no ambiguity in approval state from provided evidence
expected_effect: Payment preparation proceeds with confidence in approval legitimacy, facilitating timely vendor payment.
